card.name: Completing 'at any time' and 'if at all'
card.fires_on: The word that completes a fixed phrase of timing or degree, mainly 'time' in 'at any time' and 'all' in 'if at all'. It appears in warning text in drug labels.

modes.label: at any time
modes.description: The word 'time' after 'at any' in the NSAID warning about stomach bleeding and ulcers.
modes.example: These events can occur at any<< time>> during use and without warning symptoms.

modes.label: if at all
modes.description: The word 'all' ending the hedge 'if at all' in a caution statement.
modes.example: Cyclophosphamide should be used with caution, if at<< all>>, in patients with active urinary tract infections

card.writes: It seems to favor Chinese words for 'whenever' or 'regardless of' meanings and to suppress words like 'never' and 'anytime'.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of stock phrases like 'at any time' and 'if at all' in label warnings.
